Hale,

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, which is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and she still wants your written confirmation tonight with a date and room his class won't notice.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times and then answered her pasted-draft defence by offering to look at any other file's dates, because that gave her something she could check and nothing to argue with.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you owned the 4.2 breach in one sentence, never called Owen a liar, and never leaned on the detector score.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the work late on the night of October 28, close to that kind of night, which is why she went short and procedural there, but what she saw proves nothing about the essay and only explains why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you had already spoken to Owen under 4.1, answer that directly before moving to your next document, since she asked it, carried it into her terms, and it went unanswered.
